releaseNotes:
• Persistent floating Dynamic Island header across all screens (Settings, Profile, Room Together, Insights, Albums, Artists, Library)
• Clean, unified Apple-style profile button dock at top right of Library screen
• Seamless in-playlist song search with instant add/remove pills and spring haptics
• High-performance SQLite + JSON store for liked tracks, followed artists, saved albums, and custom playlists
• Real-time Room Together synchronized collaborative listening with fair queue and sub-millisecond clock sync
• Pure InnerTube decentralized 160 kbps Opus audio streaming on-device
• ReplayGain anti-clipping limiter with hyperbolic tangent ceiling
